UpdateSourceArgs: -c "DotnetVersion=\"{{DotnetVersion}}\"; cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && if [[ -x dotnet/dotnet ]]; then InstalledVersion=$(dotnet/dotnet --list-runtimes | sed -n \"s/^Microsoft\.AspNetCore\.App \([0-9.]*\) .*/\1/p\" | head -n1); else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; if [[ -z \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then DotnetVersion=$(wget -qO- https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/10.0/releases.json | jq -r \".[\\\"latest-runtime\\\"]\"); fi; if [[ ! \"$DotnetVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\" && exit 1; elif [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then echo \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; else [[ -f dotnet.tar.gz ]] && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO dotnet.tar.gz https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-linux-x64.tar.gz || { echo \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf dotnet/* >/dev/null 2>&1 && tar -xzf dotnet.tar.gz -C dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\"; fi"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $DotnetVersion='{{DotnetVersion}}'; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullRootDir}}'; if (Test-Path 'dotnet/dotnet.exe') { $InstalledVersion = (& dotnet/dotnet.exe --list-runtimes | Where-Object { $_ -like 'Microsoft.AspNetCore.App*' } | Select-Object -First 1).Split()[1] } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DotnetVersion) ) { $DotnetVersion=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/10.0/releases.json).\"latest-runtime\" }; if ($DotnetVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $DotnetVersion ) { Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile dotnet.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Remove-Item -Path 'dotnet/*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path \"dotnet.zip\" -DestinationPath \"dotnet\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\" }"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'tarkov/7-Zip'; if (Test-Path '7z.exe') { exit 0 } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-x64.exe' -OutFile '7z-installer.exe' }; if ($?) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7zr.exe' -OutFile '7zr.exe' }; if ($?) { & ./7zr.exe x -y -aoa 7z-installer.exe *> $null 2>&1; Remove-Item -Path '7z-installer.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"

-NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'tarkov/server'; if (Test-Path 'SPT_Runtime.bak') { Remove-Item 'SPT_Runtime.bak' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path 'SPT_Runtime') { Copy-Item -Path 'SPT_Runtime' -Destination 'SPT_Runtime.bak' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"
-c "cd tarkov/server; [[ -d SPT_Runtime.bak ]] && rm -rf SPT_Runtime.bak >/dev/null 2>&1; [[ -d SPT_Runtime ]] && \cp -rf SPT_Runtime SPT_Runtime.bak >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'tarkov/server'; $SPTVersion='{{SPTVersion}}'; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SPTVersion) ) { $SPTVersion='4.1' }; if ( $SPTVersion -notmatch '^\d+(\.\d+){0,2}$' ) { Write-Output 'Invalid SPT version format specified'; exit 1 }; $SPTPattern = $SPTVersion -replace '\.','[.]'; $Releases = (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/sp-tushonka/build/releases?per_page=100').Content; $DownloadURL = [regex]::Match($Releases, \"https://mirror\.sp-tushonka\.com/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/SPT-${SPTPattern}[.-][A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.7z\").Value; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DownloadURL) ) { Write-Output \"No download URL found for SPT $SPTVersion. The GitHub API may be rate limited, or that version does not exist. Aborting\"; exit 1 }; Write-Output \"Downloading $DownloadURL\"; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"$DownloadURL\" -OutFile 'SPT.7z'; & ../7-Zip/7z.exe x -y -aoa SPT.7z | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'SPT.7z' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"

-c "cd tarkov/server && SPTVersion='{{SPTVersion}}'; if [[ -z \"$SPTVersion\" ]]; then SPTVersion=\"4.1\"; fi; if [[ ! \"$SPTVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,2}$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid SPT version format specified\"; exit 1; fi; SPTPattern=${SPTVersion//./[.]}; DownloadURL=$(wget -qO- \"https://api.github.com/repos/sp-tushonka/build/releases?per_page=100\" | grep -Eo \"https://mirror\.sp-tushonka\.com/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/SPT-${SPTPattern}[.-][A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.7z\" | head -n 1); if [[ -z \"$DownloadURL\" ]]; then echo \"No download URL found for SPT $SPTVersion. The GitHub API may be rate limited, or that version does not exist. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; echo \"Downloading $DownloadURL\" && wget -qO SPT.7z \"$DownloadURL\" && ../7-Zip/7zzs x -y -aoa SPT.7z >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f SPT.7z >/dev/null 2>&1 && chmod +x SPT_Runtime/SPT.Server.Linux >/dev/null 2>&1"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'tarkov/server'; $FikaVersion='{{FikaVersion}}'; if ( (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($FikaVersion)) -and ($FikaVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') ) { Write-Output 'Invalid Fika Server version format specified'; exit 1 }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($FikaVersion) ) { $ReleaseURL='https://api.github.com/repos/project-fika/Fika-Server-CSharp/releases/latest' } else { $ReleaseURL=\"https://api.github.com/repos/project-fika/Fika-Server-CSharp/releases/tags/v$FikaVersion\" }; try { $Release = Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri $ReleaseURL -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"No release found for Fika Server $FikaVersion. The GitHub API may be rate limited, or that version does not exist. Aborting\"; exit 1 }; $DownloadURL = ($Release.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like '*.zip' } | Select-Object -First 1).browser_download_url; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DownloadURL) ) { Write-Output 'No download URL found for the Fika Server release. Aborting'; exit 1 }; Write-Output \"Downloading $DownloadURL\"; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"$DownloadURL\" -OutFile 'Fika.zip'; & ../7-Zip/7z.exe x -y -aoa Fika.zip | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'Fika.zip' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"

-c "cd tarkov/server && FikaVersion='{{FikaVersion}}'; if [[ -n \"$FikaVersion\" && ! \"$FikaVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Fika Server version format specified\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ -z \"$FikaVersion\" ]]; then ReleaseURL=\"https://api.github.com/repos/project-fika/Fika-Server-CSharp/releases/latest\"; else ReleaseURL=\"https://api.github.com/repos/project-fika/Fika-Server-CSharp/releases/tags/v$FikaVersion\"; fi; DownloadURL=$(wget -qO- \"$ReleaseURL\" | jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name | endswith(\".zip\")) | .browser_download_url][0] // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [[ -z \"$DownloadURL\" ]]; then echo \"No download URL found for Fika Server ${FikaVersion:-latest}. The GitHub API may be rate limited, or that version does not exist. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; echo \"Downloading $DownloadURL\" && wget -qO Fika.zip \"$DownloadURL\" && ../7-Zip/7zzs x -y -aoa Fika.zip >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f Fika.zip >/dev/null 2>&1"
